page.layout: One printed page, centred: a Greek motto line at the top, a printer's device (coat of arms in a woodcut frame) in the middle, and the imprint below the device.

main_text.l: ΟΥ ΤΟ ΜΕΓΑ ΕΥ ΑΛΛΑ ΤΟ ΕΥ ΜΕΓΑ.
Curâ authoris, Typis & expensis Ioannis Sassij,
Ordinum & Academiæ Typographi, Anno æræ Christianæ

page.notes: The device is a woodcut coat of arms (double-headed eagles and a diagonal-banded shield with hearts, under a crown and foliage frame) between the motto and the imprint; it is not text. The Greek first word is printed ΟΤ in the scan, read here as ΟΥ. "Saisij" is read as "Sassij" from a long-s form and is doubtful. Faint mirrored text from the reverse side (show-through) is left out.
